name: Ball VS Ball
creator: ATYS 3
redeem: Launch Ball VS Ball on Roblox and wait for the arena to load.
Click the present (gift) icon in the top left corner of the screen.
Pick Codes from the menu that drops down.
Type or paste a code in capitals, like UPD5, into the box and press Redeem.
notes:
Ball VS Ball is an arena battler from ATYS 3 that came out on Roblox in August 2026. Every player is a ball, and when a round starts you get a random ball to fight with. If you do not like it you can reroll mid-battle for a different one. You fight other players in the arena to be the last ball standing, and each win pays out coins.

The codes in this game all give coins, 100 per code, so the five update codes add up to 500 coins. Coins are spent in the shop and on the coin gacha to unlock new balls for your collection, so a new player can use code coins to get a few extra balls right away. So far a new code has come out with every numbered update (UPD1 through UPD5), and the developers post them in the game's Discord.

faq.q: Where is the codes button in Ball VS Ball?
faq.a: It is hidden inside the present icon in the top left corner. Click the present, then choose Codes from the list to open the text box.

faq.q: What should I spend Ball VS Ball code coins on?
faq.a: Use them on the coin gacha or the shop to unlock new balls. Each ball plays differently, so having more of them gives you better options when you reroll in a match.

faq.q: When will the next Ball VS Ball code come out?
faq.a: Every code so far has been tied to an update, from UPD1 to UPD5. New ones tend to arrive with the next update, so check the Discord announcements channel when the game gets new content.

tips: Each round you choose 1 of 3 random balls. Look at each ball's skill before you pick instead of taking the first one.
Once per match you can pick any ball from your own collection for free. Save that pick for a round where the random choices are weak.
Battles play out on their own, so your choice of ball is where the skill comes in. Pay attention to which skills win against which.
Join the group for the free reward listed on the game page, and use trading to swap balls you do not need for ones you are missing.
useRewards: All five update codes give 100 coins each, so redeeming them together adds 500 coins right away. Since you can bring any ball from your collection once per match, each new ball you unlock gives you another option in every game. Redeem the codes on your first visit so your collection grows from the start.
codeChannels: The official Ball VS Ball Discord server (announcements channel, which you may need to turn on under Channels and Roles)
